fields.help: Path to a llama-server binary (empty: bundled wheel or PATH)
Inference provider: auto (default, runs models locally on llama-server) or remote (external OpenAI-compatible endpoint)
Browser mode: extra Chromium launch flags, one per line. Defaults trim shared-memory and GPU use.
Browser mode: recycle the Chromium process every N pages to cap memory growth on long crawls (0 = never recycle).
Concurrent in-flight URLs within one crawl
Crawled pages converted to markdown on worker threads at once, so a crawl does not block request handling; 0 converts on the event loop
Regex patterns that skip URLs at link-discovery time during recursive crawls. One per line.
Random jitter (seconds) added on top of mean delay
Optional recursion-depth cap (blank = no cap; per-crawl values win)
Optional global cap on total pages per crawl (blank = no cap).
Seconds between in-flight requests within a single crawl

How crawls fetch pages. http = lightweight, no browser (default, best for static and server-rendered sites). browser = Chromium with JavaScript enabled for client-rendered sites, at much higher memory cost.
Maximum base-delay (seconds) on rate-limit responses
Minimum base-delay (seconds) on rate-limit responses
Retry count per URL when a rate-limit code comes back
Upper bound on any single backoff wait (seconds)
Enable per-domain backoff and retries on HTTP 429/503
Default page bound for an unbounded crawl, so a hostile site cannot exhaust the disk. An explicit max-pages overrides it; raise this to crawl larger sites unbounded.
Seconds between periodic re-syncs during a crawl (0 = sync only at end)
Per-page fetch timeout in seconds
Human-readable label for this lilbee, shown in the status bar. Empty falls back to 'global' for the platform default dir or to the project path (~-substituted and left-truncated).
Show the full absolute path in the status bar: expands 'global' to its on-disk path and skips ~ substitution / truncation.
Show model reasoning/thinking tokens in output
TUI color theme. Cycle with Ctrl+T; the active theme persists across sessions.

Off (default): when a chat outgrows the model's context window the oldest turns are dropped. They stay on screen but the model stops seeing them, and the context chip by the prompt shows the window filling. Costs nothing. On: those turns are condensed into a short summary the model keeps reading, so it still knows roughly what was said. That costs one extra model call each time it fires, pausing the reply for a few seconds on a GPU and considerably longer on a CPU-only machine. Worth turning on if your hardware is quick.
search runs every chat turn through document retrieval; chat skips it
Working context the dynamic picker aims for. Fits a RAG turn with reasoning headroom; raise for long-document chat.
How /v1/chat/completions presents thinking: separate reasoning_content field, inline thinking as plain content text, or off (ask the model not to think)
Keep a mixture-of-experts model's expert weights in system memory so it fits a smaller GPU. No effect on dense models.
Embedding servers in parallel (0 = auto, one per GPU; positive pins the count)

Warning: Hugging Face states this mode uses all available bandwidth and CPU cores, and buffers far more of the download in memory. Faster on a fast connection, at the cost of everything else running on the machine. Leave it off unless the machine can spare that. Requires a restart to take effect.
Flash attention. Empty (auto) enables it; disable for backends or models where it misbehaves. Resolves the V-cache padding warning on models with uneven per-layer V dims.
System prompt sent when there are no documents to ground the answer

Restrict llama.cpp to specific GPU indexes on dual-GPU machines (e.g. NVIDIA dGPU + integrated). Comma-separated, like '0' or '0,1'. Applies to Vulkan, CUDA, and ROCm. Requires a restart to take effect.
Fraction of GPU memory the model is allowed to claim (0.1-1.0)
KV cache element type. q8_0 / q4_0 halve or quarter cache memory but require flash attention to be enabled.

Primary GPU index for llama.cpp when multiple devices are visible. Empty = let llama.cpp pick (index 0). Set this together with gpu_devices to pin inference to a specific card. Requires a restart to take effect.
Maximum reasoning characters before lilbee forces the model to answer (0 = unlimited; per-model overrides apply on top)
Hard cap on generated tokens per response (blank = no cap)

Off (default): the session tools are not offered over MCP, and a connected agent cannot create or read agent sessions. On: an agent can keep its own saved conversations, separate from yours. Most agent hosts already track their own history, and the tools cost context on every request, so this stays off unless you want an agent owning conversations.
How /v1/messages presents thinking: separate thinking block, inline thinking as plain answer text, or off (ask the model not to think)
Seconds the loaded model stays warm between calls (0 = unload immediately)
Offload only the first N layers' experts to system memory. Takes precedence over the offload-everything setting; smaller N stays faster.
Layers to offload to GPU. Empty = all (recommended), 0 = CPU only, positive int = partial offload for tight VRAM.
Context window size in tokens. Leave empty to size automatically (aims for chat_n_ctx_target, ceiling at num_ctx_max or training_ctx).
Explicit ceiling for the dynamic context picker. Leave empty to use the model's training_ctx from GGUF metadata as the only ceiling. Set to cap below training_ctx (saves KV memory).
System prompt sent when answering with retrieved context
Penalty for repeating tokens
Random seed for reproducible output

On (default): conversations are saved automatically, and you can list, resume, rename, and delete them from the Sessions drawer (ctrl+o), the Sessions tab, and the /sessions command. Off: nothing is written to disk, the ctrl+o binding leaves the footer, and opening the Sessions view shows a notice that sessions are turned off. Turn it off if you would rather your chats not persist. Covers the TUI, the HTTP server, and the CLI; agent sessions have their own setting.
RAM held back for the OS in GiB when serving from system memory (no discrete GPU). Capped at a quarter of total RAM either way.
Sampling temperature (higher = more creative)
Top-K sampling: number of tokens to consider
Nucleus sampling cutoff probability
Share of a GPU placement may fill, leaving room for fragmentation and driver overhead (0.5-1.0). Raise it if a model that should fit is being refused; lower it if loads fail near the top of the card.
Vision OCR servers in parallel (0 = auto, one per GPU; positive pins the count)
Run a sync before `lilbee ask` (disable on large static corpora)
Coalesce concurrent extractions into one xberg batch call
Max files per extract_batch call when batch extraction is on
Tokens of overlap between adjacent chunks (preserves context across boundaries)
Document chunk size in tokens (changes invalidate the index)
Vision OCR for scanned PDFs (empty = auto-detect from vision_model)
Extract typed entities automatically at sync (schema induced on first run)
Wall-clock seconds one file gets to extract before ingest gives up on it (0 = no limit)
Ingest worker processes, one GPU each (0 = auto, one per card). Used once the corpus is big enough to pay for them; 1 keeps ingest in this process
Workers for discovering and hashing files (0 = auto, all available cores)
Layout-aware PDF extraction: reading order plus header/footer stripping (changes invalidate the index)

Most chunks one file can add to the index; a file over the limit is skipped, not embedded (0 = no limit). Raise it for a long document such as a thousand-page manual at a small chunk_size, then retry skipped files
Tesseract OCR languages when no vision model is set; '+'-join, e.g. eng+deu
Per-page timeout in seconds for vision OCR (0 = no limit)
Opt-in topic-aware chunker (default off; may fragment numbered procedures)
Index each extracted table as its own chunk (changes invalidate the index)
Table structure model used when layout detection is on: slanet_auto (docling-parity default), other slanet variants, tatr, or disabled (changes invalidate the index)
Per-page Tesseract timeout in seconds (used when no vision model is set)
Size chunks by real embedder tokens, not chars; on by itself when the embedder's window is below the character budget (changes invalidate the index)
Topic-boundary similarity threshold, 0.0-1.0, used when semantic chunking is on
Wall-clock seconds reserved for the vision worker to load the model. Total PDF-OCR budget = load_budget + ocr_timeout * pages.
Pages OCR'd concurrently per vision server; each slot adds KV cache memory
Hard cap on tokens generated per OCR page (bounds runaway repetition loops); raising it lengthens page generation, so give ocr_timeout headroom
Spawn every configured role server at TUI startup instead of on first use. Trades cold-start time per role for first-call latency
LM Studio server URL (blank uses http://localhost:1234/v1)
Threads for synchronous MCP tool handlers; the ceiling on how many agents one daemon serves before retrieval calls queue
Ollama server URL (blank uses http://localhost:11434)
Auto-save durable facts and preferences from each TUI turn (needs memory on)
Near-duplicate distance below which a new memory updates the old
Master switch for long-term chat memory (off by default)
Recall cutoff distance, 0.0-1.0 (lower is stricter)
Soft cap before the oldest memories are evicted
Token cap on the recalled-memory block added to the prompt
Maximum facts recalled into context per turn
LLM used for chat generation (vision and reranking are separate slots)
Passages packed into one embed request. Larger batches keep a GPU's continuous-batching slots full. The engine re-splits to its physical batch, so raising this helps only up to the server's --batch
Model used to embed document chunks
Recommend safety-stripped models in Picks and Discover (browse and search always list them)
Files allowed in their compute phase at once during ingest. 0 = auto, scaled to the detected embed fleet. Sizes the extract and embed fan-out, not the planning pass
External source roots that `add` registered, as label -> absolute path. `add` and `remove` maintain it; do not edit it by hand

Manual multi-GPU placement spec. It fully replaces the automatic planner: each active role pins to the listed device indices. Edit it with the placement commands, not the settings list. Empty uses the VRAM-aware planner
Cross-encoder model for result reranking
Relevance prompt for LLM rerankers (blank uses the built-in template)
Reranker serving mode: auto (detect cross-encoder vs LLM by model), cross_encoder, or llm
Vision model for scanned PDF OCR (empty = disabled; Tesseract only)
Scale the BM25 weight per query by vector-arm confidence, not a fixed value
Vector-similarity margin at which adaptive fusion fully silences the BM25 arm
Widen the distance cutoff when too few results pass (vector-only fallback path)
Step size for adaptive relevance-score relaxation when initial recall is empty
Chunk count to start building an ANN vector index (0 = always flat search)
Candidate-pool multiplier over top_k before reranking
Maximum boost (0-1) the concept graph can add to a chunk's relevance
Boost retrieval scores for chunks that share concepts with the query
Maximum concept tags stored per chunk (caps graph density)
LLM context sentence per chunk embedding (slow ingest; rebuild to apply)
Maximum chunks accepted from any one source (caps source dominance)
Prefix document titles to chunk embeddings (rebuild to apply)
Drop expansions that diverge from the original intent
Queries at or below this token count skip expansion (saves a model call)
Minimum cosine similarity an expansion must keep with the original query
Drop tables-of-contents and classification-banner cover pages from results
Stemmer/stop-word language for BM25 indexes (rebuild to apply)
Rewrite a follow-up that refers to earlier turns into a standalone retrieval query (one extra chat-model call on those turns)
Use HyDE (hypothetical answer expansion) to broaden retrieval
Weight on the HyDE-generated query vector when blending with the original
Classify count questions with the chat model when the fast patterns miss (covers phrasing variants and other languages; adds one short LLM call to those turns)
Route document-name lookups to exact retrieval, count questions to a scan
BM25 arm weight in fusion (1.0 = equal to vector; lower to favor dense)
Maximum unique sources contributing chunks to a single answer
Maximum vector distance for retrieval matches (lower = stricter)
Minimum RRF relevance score for hybrid search results (0.0 = no filter)
MMR lambda balancing relevance vs diversity (0 = max diversity, 1 = max relevance)
Adjacent chunks merged into each retrieved passage per side (0 = off)
Number of paraphrase expansions per query (0 disables expansion)
Blend reranker scores with retrieval fusion (off = pure reranker order)
Candidate pool size for reranking
Drop candidates whose raw reranker score is below this (unset = off)
Detect temporal queries and bias retrieval toward recent chunks
Match queries against document titles as a third hybrid-search arm
Title arm weight in rank fusion (1.0 = equal voice with the other arms)
Number of chunks returned by search
Register lilbee's MCP search tool into agent launchers (opencode, hermes). Disable to bring your own MCP servers; lilbee stays the model provider
Local documents root that lilbee sync ingests (blank = data_root/documents)
Idle minutes before the engine unloads its weights; 0 keeps them loaded
Let the engine outlive lilbee for warm launches; off stops it on last exit unless another lilbee sharing the engine asked to keep it
Seconds between SSE keep-alive frames sent to idle HTTP stream clients
Markdown vault root; results carry a vault-relative path (blank = none)

Enable the wiki layer (cited concept and entity pages). GPU-heavy: a build spends one LLM call per source document, so a large library takes hours. Enabling this generates nothing on its own: you wikify explicitly, or turn on wiki_auto_update
Regenerate touched wiki pages after each sync (off: wikify explicitly)

Minimum chunks a source must contribute before its batched call includes concept curation. Sources below the floor skip the concept-curation instruction; sources with zero entities AND below the floor are skipped entirely.
Synthesis clusterer backend (embedding or concepts)
Mutual-kNN neighborhood size for the clusterer (0 = auto)
Max fraction of changed lines before regeneration requires review
Minimum cosine similarity (0-1) between a generated page and the mean of its source chunk vectors before publishing. Pages below the threshold route to drafts/.
Prompt for the per-source batched call. Must keep {source}, {entity_list}, {chunks_text}, and {concept_instruction}.
Minimum chunk mentions before an entity or concept gets its own page
Entity extraction strategy. ner_entities (typed spaCy NER) is the only implemented mode; the other values fall back to it with a warning
Prompt for a single page generated on demand from one subject's chunks across every source naming it. Must keep {topic}, {source_list}, and {chunks_text}.
Whether the per-source batched call asks the LLM to curate concept pages alongside the pre-extracted entity list.
Touched-page cap for auto-update after sync. Beyond this count, run `lilbee wiki update` manually.
Delete raw chunks after summarizing into the wiki
Fraction of stale citations before a page is flagged by wiki prune
How many source chunks a page kept for lazy generation draws on. Caps the browse index's size; already more than one page's context budget admits, so raising it rarely changes what a page says
Maximum tokens generated per wiki page
Prompt for cross-source synthesis pages. Must keep {topic}, {source_list}, and {chunks_text}.
Temperature used for wiki page synthesis (low = stay close to sources)
